podcast.title: Portastudio Recordings (Early 1990s)
podcast.body: Based in Dayton, Ohio, Robert Pollard worked with his band Guided By Voices, utilizing a Portastudio unit for their recordings in the early 1990s. This choice of home recording equipment aligned him with the low-fidelity movement, showcasing an artistic preference for accessible and unpolished production methods. "Meanwhile, Robert Pollard was out in Dayton, Ohio, working with his band, Guided By Voices, using a port of studio unit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Portastudio Recordings (Early 1990s)
xref.body: This band, based in Dayton, Ohio, under the leadership of Robert Pollard, was actively recording their music using a Portastudio unit during the early 1990s. Their embrace of this home recording technology placed them firmly within the burgeoning low-fidelity scene, reflecting a widespread artistic choice to prioritize raw expression over polished production. "Meanwhile, Robert Pollard was out in Dayton, Ohio, working with his band, Guided By Voices, using a port of studio unit."
